summary: Accepted as a qualified teacher-role virtual-render-tree falsifier: E3003 records a fresh execution of the unchanged E3002 probe with status 0, empty stderr, matching stdout hash, and unchanged probe/source hashes. The raw stdout intentionally carries job_id E3002 because it is the unchanged probe payload; E3003 execution/result files identify the new run. Assertions support the reported filter/back/clear/pagination/sort and role-visibility observations. No product defect was reproduced; no browser/DOM, backend, real-account, production, or broader test-suite claim is made.
